memories.title: Default Rollup interval
memories.statement: Session Chain Rollup uses five sealed Segments per default window.

memories.title: Policy layer remains excluded
memories.statement: Pi-XK does not add a general Policy layer or sandbox in Memory v1.

memories.title: Memory manifest is metadata only
memories.statement: D0 exposes counts and tool guidance but never memory bodies, cue titles, or historical user text.

memories.title: Goal contract revision boundary
memories.statement: The model proposes Goal objective refinement through revision CAS and cannot edit the objective projection directly.

memories.title: Explicit purge keeps a tombstone
memories.statement: Memory purge requires confirmation, detached evidence, no active edge, and permanently retains a source-digest tombstone.

memories.title: Git freshness is path scoped
memories.statement: Only changes to the recorded repository-relative scope paths make code memory stale; unrelated dirty files do not.

memories.title: Heat is ranking only
memories.statement: Access heat is bounded to a ten percent ranking contribution and never changes lifecycle or deletes memory.

memories.title: Task input uses the native queue
memories.statement: Ordinary user input waits in the Pi queue while a child Task is running and is processed after Task delivery.

memories.title: Manual compaction resumes on the next request
memories.statement: A manual compaction without an Active Goal waits for the next real user request before recovery.

memories.title: Legacy compaction immediate resume claim
memories.statement: An older note claims every manual compaction should immediately call the model again.
